name: lispan_rate_0.1-1C
description: Phase 3a: rate-parametric Li-SPAN forward PINN (src/dfn_pinn/lispan/rate_pinn.py). One network for every C-rate in [0.1, 1] C (log-uniform sampling); time normalized per rate by the window t_end(r) fitted to FV cut-off times at 0.1/0.2/0.5/1 C. Same physics, cell (Simanjuntak 2024, Z_CC 0.025, reactions 2 and 3 irreversible) and recipe as configs/lispan_forward_final_*.json, with twice the collocation points and steps for the extra input dimension. Evaluated at 7 rates, 3 of them not used for the window.
